Triage: **`pm:queue`** (whole-repo backlog — no domain labels in this repo).

- **Landing verified** @ objectui `origin/main` `bd863fe`, all four anchors live by direct read: `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx:464` (fallback branch) and the `HomeActivity onViewAll` drill; `packages/app-shell/src/layout/InboxPopover.tsx` `goToAllNotifications` / `goToAllActivity` both `navigate` to the hardcoded setup-app paths, while `goToApprovals` and `handleNotificationClick` directly beside them already resolve `currentAppName ?? params.appName`. The contrast pair makes this a same-shape completion of the landed objectstack-ai/objectstack#7231 fix, not a new design question — the in-code ADR-0030 comment argues the OBJECT is app-independent, which does not entail rendering it in `setup`.
- **Queue, not finding**: a business user without setup access has a dead "see all" on the bell popover and Home today (symptom inferred from routing, as the card honestly notes — the fix card should verify the guard behavior first).
- **Scope guard carried over**: the two admin-scoped marketplace/apps links are deliberately excluded; do not sweep them in without a decision.
- **Dedup**: no open objectui shadow (searches for the inbox object and component came back empty; counterprobed the searcher against a known-present term).

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

**Confirmed in a browser against a real non-admin session**, closing the one gap this card names about itself ("I did **not** verify the failure end-to-end in a browser against a non-admin session … inferred from the routing, not measured"). Done as part of objectstack-ai/objectstack#7331, which browser-verifies the objectstack-ai/objectstack#7213 entry convergence.

## Setup

`examples/app-showcase` booted from framework `88154bee1`, bundled console built from this repo at the pinned `8aad9fd50b16` (`packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` matches `.objectui-sha`). Persona: a user created at runtime holding only business positions (`contributor` + `finance`, plus the implicit `org_member` / `everyone`). `GET /api/v1/meta/app` for that session returns `showcase_app` and `account` and **not** `setup` — so this is the exact audience the card describes.

## Measured

**`InboxPopover` `goToAllNotifications`** (anchor 3). Opening the bell popover and clicking **View all notifications**:

```
-> http://localhost:3811/_console/apps/setup/sys_inbox_message?view=mine
```

**`HomePage` `HomeActivity onViewAll`** (anchor 2). On `/_console/home`, clicking **View all activity**:

```
-> http://localhost:3811/_console/apps/setup/sys_activity
```

Both anchors reproduce exactly as written. The two remaining anchors were not separately driven: `goToAllActivity` is the same string as anchor 2 reached from the popover's Activity tab, and `onOpenNotification`'s fallback needs a notification with no `action_url`.

## The user-visible symptom, since it was the open question

Not an "App not available" shell guard. The router renders the target **inside the current app's shell** — the breadcrumb and sidebar stayed on *Showcase* while the URL said `/apps/setup/...` — and the page then shows the object's **"You don't have access"** empty state, because the data read is refused:

```
GET /api/v1/data/sys_inbox_message?top=20&sort=-created_at&filter=[…user_id…] -> 403 PERMISSION_DENIED
GET /api/v1/data/sys_activity?top=200&sort=timestamp                          -> 403 PERMISSION_DENIED
```

So it is a softer failure than a hard app guard, and correspondingly more confusing: the shell looks fine and only the content is refused.

## One thing a fix here will not fully close

The `403` above is a **second, independent** cause, filed separately as objectstack-ai/objectstack#7344: `sys_inbox_message` is granted by no shipped permission set — `member_default`, the additive `everyone` baseline, does not name it. So re-pointing these four anchors at an app the user *can* open leaves them on the same "You don't have access" state until that grant question is settled. Verified directly: the **Account** app's own `Notifications` entry (`sys_inbox_message`, no `setup` involved anywhere) renders the identical empty state for this persona.

Worth knowing before someone measures a fix for this card and reads the unchanged empty state as "the fix did not work". The routing fix is still correct and still needed; it is just not sufficient on its own.

## Contrast — the sibling that already works

The approvals row directly above these, which objectstack-ai/objectstack#7234 fixed, resolves correctly for the same session in the same run: Home's **pending approvals** card navigates to `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/system/approvals` — a package the user can open — and renders the inbox. That is the shape this card asks for.

## Browser-verified — the inferred symptom is real, and it is a hard app switch

This card states: *"I did **not** verify the failure end-to-end in a browser against a non-admin session, so the user-visible symptom … is inferred from the routing, not measured."* Closing half of that gap with a measurement.

**Environment** — objectstack `main` (`88154bee1`) with the vendored console rebuilt at the current pin `.objectui-sha` = `8aad9fd50b16`, `examples/app-showcase` on a fresh seeded DB (`objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin`), zh-CN, signed in as the dev admin.

**Measured, from inside a business app** (Showcase, `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/...`):

| Producer | Click | Resulting `location.pathname` |
|---|---|---|
| `InboxPopover` `goToAllNotifications` | bell → 查看全部通知 | `/_console/apps/**setup**/sys_inbox_message` |
| `HomePage` `HomeActivity onViewAll` | Home → 查看全部动态 | `/_console/apps/**setup**/sys_activity` |

Both anchors fire exactly as described, and both leave the app the user was in: the console re-renders with the Setup sidebar and the header app switcher reading 系统设置. So the defect is not only "a dead link for a user without setup access" — for **every** user it is an unannounced app switch out of the business app, with no way back except the app switcher.

Same session, same popover, the approvals row directly above resolves to the current app (`/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/system/approvals`) — the asymmetry this card describes is visible in one screenshot.

**Still not measured**: the non-admin side. I had no second account with a usable password on the seeded instance and did not create one, so what a user *without* setup access sees at the destination (shell "App not available" guard vs. something softer) remains inferred, as originally stated. The two anchors above are now fact rather than inference; the failure mode at the far end is not.

The other two anchors on the card (`HomePage.tsx:464` notification fallback, `InboxPopover.tsx:137` `goToAllActivity`) were not exercised — the seeded notification carried an `action_url`, so the fallback branch never ran.

**CLAIM** (objectui whole-repo seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`) — dispatching a dev agent now.

- Branch `claude/issue-4074-inbox-links-app-resolve`, worktree `objectui-issue-4074` (S/M container)
- Direction per the card's suggested shape + the two browser verifications above: ONE shared helper (the objectstack#7231 resolution — last-open app re-checked against the live active-app list → first active app → `setup` last) applied to all four anchors, replacing the deliberate-exception comments whose ADR-0030 argument (object is app-independent) does not entail rendering in `setup`. The two admin-scoped marketplace/apps links stay excluded, per the card's scope guard.
- **Known second cause, do not misread**: objectstack#7344 (no shipped permission set grants `sys_inbox_message`) means the destination may STILL show the no-access empty state for business users after this fix — the routing fix is necessary, not sufficient; the pins assert the resolved TARGET, not the far end's data grant.

**ACCEPT** (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, review of record) — PR #4242, CI fully green.

The helper is the ruled anti-drift shape done properly: `resolveHostAppSegment` LIFTS the objectstack#7231 HomePage resolution (with `filterActiveApps` absorbing the previously-inline predicate) rather than competing with it, and both surfaces consume it through the same metadata context, so Home and the popover cannot drift. The resolution order contains one measured improvement the dispatch did not ask for and the review endorses: the preferred app passes UNCHECKED only when the catalog names no apps at all — an empty list is "not loaded yet" as often as "no apps", and without that step a user standing inside `/apps/crm/...` would be demoted to setup during the pre-catalog render, the same defect in a loading race. All four anchors resolve; the deliberate-exception comments are replaced with the corrected reasoning (app-independence is exactly why the object renders under whatever app the user can open); the admin-scoped links are pinned as STAYING setup; the setup-as-last-open tail still resolves setup. Pins assert the `navigate()` argument only, with the objectstack#7344 second-cause caveat restated in both PR and changeset so nobody misreads the far end's empty state. The TS2871-driven imperative deviation is flagged, typed clean, and each fallback step pinned individually. Reverse verification: exactly the 13 target cases red, every control and helper unit green. Flipping ready + auto-merge.
